name: model-lineup
title: Model lineup
description: A model family compared on what matters: best for, context window, speed and price per million tokens, with one model marked Recommended in words.
docs: Pass models (an id, a name, a tier, bestFor, context in tokens, speed from 1 to 3, priceIn and priceOut per million tokens, an href and, for the one you would pick first, recommended), plus currency and locale for the prices. Context is written compactly ("200K") and every figure is tabular. Speed is a three-segment meter with a word beside it: Fast, Faster or Fastest, never the meter alone. On a wide block the models are rows of a real table with a caption, where the row header is the model's name, its tier and the Recommended mark, and what it is best for has a column of its own; the column of links is left out when no model has an href. On a narrow block each is a card with the same labels. Add a note under it for billing details. The block has no state and renders on the server. Words are translated through labels.
